hero.h1: Catch Basin Cleaning and Repair in Ravenswood, Chicago
hero.sub: A gangway that floods, a yard drain buried in leaves or a back patio that won't drain. We clean and repair catch basins and the lines behind them. Our office is on Ravenswood Avenue.

img.alt: Cast iron catch basin grate at the edge of an asphalt driveway, partly covered with fallen leaves next to a landscaped garden bed

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: A catch basin is a small chamber under a grate. It collects water from a yard, gangway, patio or downspout and sends it into a drain line, while leaves and grit settle in the bottom. In older Chicago yards, many basins connect to the building sewer, so a clog can affect more than the yard.

img.alt: Diagram of a catch basin showing the inlet grate, water line, sediment settling in the sump and the outlet pipe carrying water away

blocks.h2: Signs a Ravenswood Catch Basin Needs Service

tiles.body: Water heads for the basement walls.

blocks.intro: Narrow lots and old trees make catch basins work hard here.

items.body: Runoff funnels straight to basement walls and stairwells.
Some older basins drain to the building sewer, so storms can back them up.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: The narrow gangway between two buildings collects rain from two roofs and two walls. If the drain at the bottom is clogged, water has nowhere to go but toward the basement walls and stairwells. Leaves from parkway trees, sand and debris settle in these small basins quickly. A yearly cleaning, and a check that the outlet still drains, is one of the cheapest ways to keep water out of an older Ravenswood basement.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Catch Basin Work
blocks.body: A cleaning is quick. Rebuilding an old brick basin or clearing a clogged outlet takes more. If the basin ties into the sewer, line work may be part of it. We look first and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Catch Basin Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: How often should a catch basin be cleaned?
items.answer: At least once a year, usually after the leaves fall.

items.q: Can a clogged basin flood my basement?
items.answer: Yes. Water that pools by the building can come in through walls, window wells or stairwells.

items.q: Can you rebuild an old brick basin?
items.answer: Often. We rebuild walls and reset grates, or replace it.

items.q: Is my gangway drain a catch basin?
items.answer: Often, yes. It needs the same yearly cleaning.

items.q: Who maintains a gangway drain shared by two buildings?
items.answer: It depends on whose property it's on. Often the two owners split it.

items.q: Can you clear a drain at the bottom of basement stairs?
items.answer: Yes. These clog with leaves and flood the door when they do.

items.q: How much does catch basin work cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the job. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether it's a cleaning, a repair or line work. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
